entries: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRATHINK`, which turns the `ultrathink` keyword off
Added pooled group budgets to the Claude apps gateway: one monthly budget that a group's members share, on top of each member's own limit, set with `pooled_budget` on the spend limits admin API
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_LOOPED_CROSS_CERT_DROP` to keep system cross-certificates that certify each other in a loop, for servers whose private CA needs one
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT` to set the effort level subagents run at when nothing else names one, instead of inheriting the session's
Added `managed.policy_mode: layered` to the Claude apps gateway: every policy that matches a developer applies, each merged over the ones listed below it, not only the first

Added `guardrail.input_tagging` on Claude apps gateway Bedrock upstreams, which wraps prompts in the input tags that an Amazon Bedrock guardrail's prompt attacks filter needs; `all_messages_and_system` also tags the system prompt

Deprecated fast mode for Opus 4.8 as of October 30, 2026; it will be removed on November 30, 2026. After removal, fast mode requests on Opus 4.8 return an error and do not fall back to standard Opus 4.8. Migrate to Opus 5.5 to keep the speedup
Fixed shell commands being left running on macOS and Linux when Claude Code exits by itself, for example when credentials are refused or a cloud session is archived
Fixed bash aliases with line breaks in their value (except in Git Bash), and functions whose names start with a dash, being garbled or lost in the Bash tool's shell
Fixed bash scripts started from the Bash tool stopping after their first command when `SHELLOPTS` is exported
Fixed PowerShell hooks not blocking on exit code 2 when the command begins with a type cast, `param`, `using` or an attribute
Fixed some network requests hanging when a compressed response was cut off or corrupted
Fixed `sonnet`, `opus` and `haiku` on Vertex AI and Amazon Bedrock showing an error mid-session instead of switching to an older model when the newest is not yet available to the account or region
Fixed the Claude apps gateway not checking every model a request names against `availableModels`, `deniedModels` and `models`; a request that names a blocked model now gets a 400 naming the field
Fixed `claude auth login` refusing to run where managed settings require a Claude apps gateway; in a terminal it now shows the gateway sign-in
Fixed `--restricted` sessions uploading files from outside the working directories when a Read allow rule covered them
Fixed prompts containing invisible characters needing a second Enter to send; plain prompts now send cleaned on the first Enter, and commands still wait for review
Fixed sub-agents that inherited a parent sub-agent's model moving to the main model when a background job or message woke them
Fixed a managed `autoMode.allow` list without `"$defaults"` getting the built-in exceptions back from a host app's `--settings`, a first rule added in `/permissions`, or `/auto-mode-setup`
Fixed cloud sessions and cloud scheduled tasks not being marked as failed when auto mode stopped a turn because the server returned no safety verdict
Fixed `claude -p` text output sometimes not saying why auto mode stopped a turn when a background agent was still running
Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1` being ignored in sessions started by a host application (such as Claude Desktop) behind a proxy or LLM gateway with experimental betas turned off
Fixed plugin MCP `headersHelper` scripts receiving a corrupted `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` and server URL when a credential-named environment variable was set to a switch value such as `1`
Fixed the SDK `register_repo_root` control request not loading the CLAUDE.md of a directory outside the working directory (with `CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_DIRECTORIES_CLAUDE_MD=1`)
Fixed the Artifact tool showing `?` for artifact database access rules at the `self` level, and not quoting those rules back when it refuses a republish that would drop them
Fixed `/model <id>` not warning when the model isn't recognized by this version and auto-compact will assume a 200K context window
Fixed the "hold space to speak" hint using up its three showings in one session, and showing an empty key when push-to-talk is unbound
Fixed Grep and Glob never returning when the search process is killed at the timeout but does not exit, seen on Windows
Fixed a rare case where resuming a conversation did not restore its plan, when `/clear` or `/resume` had been run while part of that conversation was still being saved
Fixed first-run setup dropping words from the security notes and the terminal-setup explanation in narrow terminals
Fixed the Enterprise survey card taking a typed 1 or 0 after a short pause; a typed answer now needs Enter
Self-hosted runner: Fixed a message sent while Claude was working being answered after a Stop, once the session's process had been replaced
Self-hosted runner: Fixed an MCP server's on/off switch sometimes being lost when a session moved to a new machine
Windows: Fixed the Bash tool losing your aliases and functions in Git Bash when the rc file sets errexit and pipefail and only winpty aliases, or none, are defined
Improved `/code-review` started from the Code tab in Claude Desktop or on the web: cloud and `claude remote-control` sessions now show the findings card, not a plain-text list
Improved `/diff` on large repositories: each refresh usually runs one fewer full-repository git command, and refreshes are spaced out when git is slow

Improved the messages shown when `/ultrareview`, a cloud session or a cloud agent finds no GitHub remote: they now say to create a repository at https://github.com/new, and `/ultrareview` no longer suggests a `gh` command that `gh` rejects
Improved SSL certificate errors to name the likely causes, among them a server that leaves out an intermediate certificate, and the fix for each
Changed auto mode so that an `autoMode.allow` list without `"$defaults"` no longer removes the built-in rule on scheduled-task prompts
Changed server-managed settings for Team and Enterprise logins: settings fetched from Anthropic's API now apply without an approval prompt, and a stored copy that doesn't verify is refused
[VSCode] Added sign-in to a Claude apps gateway from the chat panel, with no terminal needed
[VSCode] Changed `ultrathink` to run its turn at `xhigh` effort and show in a rainbow in the chat box, as in the terminal
[VSCode] Fixed the missing Effort slider, Ultracode switch and model name when the model setting has the `[1m]` tag, such as `opus[1m]`
[VSCode] Fixed saved `/btw` side-question history being deleted too early while a settings file has errors
[VSCode] Fixed a conversation coming back in Auto mode after a reload or restart when its plan was approved with "Yes, and manually approve edits"
[Cloud sessions] Added a form card to cloud sessions, so you can fill in or decline a form an MCP server asks for instead of the request being canceled without you seeing it
[Cloud sessions] Added a "Catching up…" line that shows while a cloud or Remote Control session you switch back to is still bringing its messages up to date
[Cloud sessions] Changed network secrets so Enterprise members can add and delete them on their own cloud environments, instead of only viewing them
[Cloud sessions] Improved the Changes pane for cloud sessions: the note about what the list leaves out is now a badge beside the branch name, not a row above the diff
[Cloud sessions] Fixed file search in a cloud session's Files pane showing folders as ../.. paths after Claude changed directory; results now show their path from the project's root
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude refusing to edit or append to a canvas it made in a Slack channel, from that channel, once the canvas was also shared to another channel or a DM
[Claude Tag] Fixed untagged replies going unanswered in a Slack Connect thread when both organizations have installed Claude and Slack delivered the reply to the other organization's app
[Claude Tag] Fixed a cloud scheduled task's live status checklist in Slack staying half-done; a run can now edit the top-level messages it posted during that run
[Claude Tag] Changed a Slack channel's Respond automatically switch to a "How Claude participates" choice on the channel's Configure page and in Claude Tag admin settings
[Code Review] Added a findings-by-severity card to the Code Review analytics page, showing the period's total findings, a daily chart stacked by severity, and each severity's count

title.zh-TW: Slack 跨頻道畫布可接續編輯，參與方式設定更名
title.en: Slack Cross-Channel Canvases Allow Continued Edits, Participation Setting Renamed

body.zh-TW: 在 Slack 跨組織討論或跨頻道共用畫布時，你可能遇過回覆沒人接、Claude 拒絕編輯的狀況。以前 Claude 在頻道自己建立的 Canvas 畫布，另分享至其他頻道或私訊後，就會拒絕在原頻道編輯或追加內容；現在已恢復支援。在兩家公司皆啟用 Claude 的 Slack Connect 討論串中，未特別標註的回覆也不再因轉發至另一家公司的應用程式而漏接。雲端排程的即時清單現在能直接更新當次發出的頂層訊息，避免進度卡在未完成狀態。頻道 Configure 設定頁與 Claude Tag 管理設定中的自動回應開關，都改為「Claude 參與方式」選單。
body.en: When collaborating across organizations or sharing canvases across channels in Slack, you may have encountered unanswered replies or Claude refusing to edit. Previously, once a canvas Claude created in a channel was shared to another channel or a direct message, it refused to edit or append content from that channel; this support has now been restored. In Slack Connect threads where both organizations have enabled Claude, untagged replies no longer go unanswered when forwarded to the other organization's app. The live checklist for cloud scheduled tasks can now directly update top-level messages posted during that run, preventing progress from staying half-done. On a channel's Configure page and in Claude Tag admin settings, the Respond automatically switch has been changed to a "How Claude participates" menu.

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude refusing to edit or append to a canvas it made in a Slack channel, from that channel, once the canvas was also shared to another channel or a DM
[Claude Tag] Fixed untagged replies going unanswered in a Slack Connect thread when both organizations have installed Claude and Slack delivered the reply to the other organization's app
[Claude Tag] Fixed a cloud scheduled task's live status checklist in Slack staying half-done; a run can now edit the top-level messages it posted during that run
[Claude Tag] Changed a Slack channel's Respond automatically switch to a "How Claude participates" choice on the channel's Configure page and in Claude Tag admin settings

title.zh-TW: 雲端工作階段支援 MCP 表單填寫，密鑰管理與路徑顯示最佳化
title.en: Cloud Sessions Support MCP Form Completion, Secret Management and Path Display Refined

body.zh-TW: 當你透過瀏覽器切換雲端工作階段處理專案，各種互動提示與環境權限有了明確回饋。現在當 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器提出表單請求，介面會跳出卡片讓你填寫或拒絕，不再無預警直接取消。切回雲端或 Remote Control 遠端控制工作階段時，若訊息還在同步更新，畫面會顯示「Catching up…」。企業版成員能在個人雲端環境新增或刪除網路密鑰，不再限制只能檢視。雲端工作階段的 Files 檔案面板搜尋，修好了 Claude 切換目錄後把資料夾顯示成 ../.. 路徑的問題，改為顯示自專案根目錄起算的路徑。變更面板的省略說明也收納成分支名稱旁的徽章。
body.en: When switching between cloud sessions in a browser to work on projects, interactive prompts and environment permissions now offer clearer feedback. Now, when an MCP (a protocol connecting AI to external tools) server requests a form, a card pops up in the interface for you to fill in or decline instead of the request being canceled without warning. When switching back to a cloud or Remote Control session while messages are still updating, the screen displays "Catching up…". Enterprise members can now add and delete network secrets in their personal cloud environments, rather than being restricted to view-only access. In a cloud session's Files pane search, a bug where folders appeared as ../.. paths after Claude changed directory has been fixed, and paths now show from the project root. The note explaining what the Changes pane leaves out has also been moved into a badge beside the branch name.

items.original:
[Cloud sessions] Added a form card to cloud sessions, so you can fill in or decline a form an MCP server asks for instead of the request being canceled without you seeing it
[Cloud sessions] Added a "Catching up…" line that shows while a cloud or Remote Control session you switch back to is still bringing its messages up to date
[Cloud sessions] Changed network secrets so Enterprise members can add and delete them on their own cloud environments, instead of only viewing them
[Cloud sessions] Improved the Changes pane for cloud sessions: the note about what the list leaves out is now a badge beside the branch name, not a row above the diff
[Cloud sessions] Fixed file search in a cloud session's Files pane showing folders as ../.. paths after Claude changed directory; results now show their path from the project's root

title.zh-TW: VSCode 面板支援閘道登入，思考彩虹特效與介面控制項修復
title.en: VSCode Panel Supports Gateway Sign-In, Thinking Rainbow Effect and UI Controls Fixed

body.zh-TW: 在 VSCode 側邊欄與 Claude 協同撰寫程式碼時，登入內部服務與微調思考強度有了更完整的介面支援。現在聊天面板可直接登入企業的 Claude apps 閘道器，無須另外開啟終端機。在對話輸入 `ultrathink`，會讓當回合採用 `xhigh` 極高思考力度，並在聊天輸入框呈現彩虹效果。模型設定帶有 `[1m]` 標記時，Effort 思考力度滑桿、Ultracode 開關與模型名稱也都恢復顯示。設定檔出錯時，已儲存的 `/btw` 提問紀錄不會再被意外清除。若先前已指定手動審核修改，重新載入編輯器後也不會誤跳回自動模式。
body.en: When collaborating on code with Claude in the VSCode sidebar, signing in to internal services and fine-tuning thinking effort now have more complete interface support. The chat panel can now sign in directly to an enterprise Claude apps gateway without opening a separate terminal. Entering `ultrathink` in a conversation runs that turn at `xhigh` effort and displays a rainbow effect in the chat box. When model settings carry the `[1m]` tag, the Effort slider, Ultracode switch, and model name are restored. When a configuration file contains errors, saved `/btw` question history will no longer be wiped accidentally. If manual approval of edits was previously specified, reloading the editor will no longer mistakenly revert to Auto mode.

items.original:
[VSCode] Added sign-in to a Claude apps gateway from the chat panel, with no terminal needed
[VSCode] Changed `ultrathink` to run its turn at `xhigh` effort and show in a rainbow in the chat box, as in the terminal
[VSCode] Fixed the missing Effort slider, Ultracode switch and model name when the model setting has the `[1m]` tag, such as `opus[1m]`
[VSCode] Fixed saved `/btw` side-question history being deleted too early while a settings file has errors
[VSCode] Fixed a conversation coming back in Auto mode after a reload or restart when its plan was approved with "Yes, and manually approve edits"

title.zh-TW: 程式碼審查改採結構化卡片，分析頁新增嚴重度統計圖表
title.en: Code Review Adopts Structured Cards, Analytics Page Adds Severity Charts

body.zh-TW: 當你提交程式碼請 Claude 協助把關專案品質，產出的審查摘要與分析統計現在一目了然。從桌面版或網頁的 Code 分頁發起 `/code-review` 時，雲端與 `claude remote-control` 遠端控制工作階段會直接顯示結構化的審查結果卡片，取代純文字清單。分析頁面的嚴重程度卡片會顯示所選期間的問題總數、每日依嚴重程度堆疊的圖表，以及各級數量。執行 `/ultrareview`、雲端工作階段或雲端代理找不到 GitHub 遠端關聯時，訊息會指引你到 https://github.com/new 建立儲存庫；其中 `/ultrareview` 也不再推薦會被 `gh` 拒絕的指令。
body.en: When submitting code for Claude to review project quality, the resulting review summaries and analytical statistics are now immediately clear. Starting `/code-review` from the Code tab in Claude Desktop or on the web now displays a structured findings card in cloud and `claude remote-control` sessions instead of a plain-text list. The findings-by-severity card on the analytics page shows the period's total findings, a daily chart stacked by severity, and counts for each severity level. When `/ultrareview`, a cloud session, or a cloud agent finds no GitHub remote, the message guides you to create a repository at https://github.com/new; in addition, `/ultrareview` no longer recommends a command that `gh` rejects.

items.original:
Improved `/code-review` started from the Code tab in Claude Desktop or on the web: cloud and `claude remote-control` sessions now show the findings card, not a plain-text list
Improved the messages shown when `/ultrareview`, a cloud session or a cloud agent finds no GitHub remote: they now say to create a repository at https://github.com/new, and `/ultrareview` no longer suggests a `gh` command that `gh` rejects
[Code Review] Added a findings-by-severity card to the Code Review analytics page, showing the period's total findings, a daily chart stacked by severity, and each severity's count

title.zh-TW: Bash 工具完整保留別名與函式，背景命令退出不再殘留
title.en: Bash Tool Retains Aliases and Functions, Background Commands No Longer Linger on Exit

body.zh-TW: 當你透過終端機交由 Claude 執行腳本，自訂 Shell（執行指令的環境）的相容性有了修正。macOS 或 Linux 上，Claude Code 因憑證遭拒或雲端工作階段歸檔而自行退出時，不再留下仍執行中的命令。Bash 工具不再弄亂或遺失含換行的別名，但不含 Git Bash；減號開頭的函式名稱也已修好。匯出 `SHELLOPTS` 的腳本不再執行第一句就停擺。Windows 的 Git Bash 若在 rc 啟動設定檔同時設定 errexit 與 pipefail，且只定義 winpty 別名或沒有別名，也不再遺失別名與函式。PowerShell 掛鉤（特定事件觸發的小程式）的指令以型別轉換、`param`、`using` 或屬性開頭時，也能依結束代碼 2 阻擋執行。
body.en: When having Claude run scripts through the terminal, compatibility with a custom shell (an environment for running commands) has been improved. On macOS or Linux, when Claude Code exits on its own because credentials are refused or a cloud session is archived, it no longer leaves running commands behind. The Bash tool no longer garbles or loses aliases containing line breaks—except in Git Bash—and functions whose names start with a dash are now fixed. Scripts that export `SHELLOPTS` no longer stall right after their first command. In Windows Git Bash, when an rc startup file sets both errexit and pipefail while defining only winpty aliases or none at all, aliases and functions are no longer lost. When commands in PowerShell hooks (small programs triggered by specific events) start with a type cast, `param`, `using`, or an attribute, they also properly block execution on exit code 2.

items.original:
Fixed shell commands being left running on macOS and Linux when Claude Code exits by itself, for example when credentials are refused or a cloud session is archived
Fixed bash aliases with line breaks in their value (except in Git Bash), and functions whose names start with a dash, being garbled or lost in the Bash tool's shell
Fixed bash scripts started from the Bash tool stopping after their first command when `SHELLOPTS` is exported
Fixed PowerShell hooks not blocking on exit code 2 when the command begins with a type cast, `param`, `using` or an attribute
Windows: Fixed the Bash tool losing your aliases and functions in Git Bash when the rc file sets errexit and pipefail and only winpty aliases, or none, are defined

title.zh-TW: 自動模式權限規則防意外覆寫，中斷狀態與伺服器判定修復
title.en: Auto Mode Permission Rules Prevent Accidental Overwrites, Interruption Status and Server Verdicts Fixed

body.zh-TW: 在自動模式下讓 Claude 連續執行任務時，權限清單與中斷原因不該讓你摸不著頭緒。受管理的 `autoMode.allow` 允許清單未含 `"$defaults"` 時，不再因主應用程式的 `--settings`、首次在 `/permissions` 加規則或 `/auto-mode-setup`，而加回內建例外；排程任務提示的內建規則也不會因此被移除。雲端工作階段與排程任務若因伺服器未回傳安全判定、由自動模式停止該回合，會確實標記失敗。背景代理仍在執行時，`claude -p` 文字輸出也會交代自動模式停止回合的原因。由主應用程式啟動、經代理伺服器或 LLM 大型語言模型閘道器連線且關閉實驗性測試功能時，環境變數 `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1` 不再被忽略。
body.en: When having Claude run tasks continuously in auto mode, permission lists and reasons for interruptions should never leave you guessing. When a managed `autoMode.allow` list omits "$defaults", built-in exceptions are no longer reintroduced by a host app's `--settings`, a first rule added in `/permissions`, or `/auto-mode-setup`; nor is the built-in rule on scheduled-task prompts removed because of this. Cloud sessions and scheduled tasks are now properly marked as failed when auto mode stops a turn because the server returned no safety verdict. While a background agent is still running, `claude -p` text output also explains why auto mode stopped a turn. In sessions started by a host application through a proxy or an LLM (large language model) gateway with experimental features turned off, the `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1` environment variable is no longer ignored.

items.original:
Fixed a managed `autoMode.allow` list without `"$defaults"` getting the built-in exceptions back from a host app's `--settings`, a first rule added in `/permissions`, or `/auto-mode-setup`
Fixed cloud sessions and cloud scheduled tasks not being marked as failed when auto mode stopped a turn because the server returned no safety verdict
Fixed `claude -p` text output sometimes not saying why auto mode stopped a turn when a background agent was still running
Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1` being ignored in sessions started by a host application (such as Claude Desktop) behind a proxy or LLM gateway with experimental betas turned off
Changed auto mode so that an `autoMode.allow` list without `"$defaults"` no longer removes the built-in rule on scheduled-task prompts

title.zh-TW: 憑證錯誤提示列出具體解法，保留私有 CA 所需的交叉憑證
title.en: Certificate Errors Detail Actionable Fixes, Retaining Cross-Certificates for Private CAs

body.zh-TW: 當工具在企業內網或受管網路發送請求，遇到連線驗證失敗時不再只丟出一行模糊代碼。⟦跟海關查驗護照上的簽證戳章一樣，如果發現缺少中介審核章，系統會直接指出漏蓋了哪一關，而不是冷冷關閉閘門。⟧現在遇到 SSL 憑證錯誤，終端機會直接分析可能原因，例如伺服器遺漏了中介憑證，並附上具體的修正指引。針對需要內部私有憑證的架構，可啟用環境變數 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_LOOPED_CROSS_CERT_DROP`，保留系統中循環互簽的交叉憑證。另外，當伺服器回傳的壓縮資料中途截斷或損毀時，網路請求也不會再無限期卡死。
body.en: When tools send requests across an enterprise intranet or managed network, connection verification failures no longer throw a vague line of code. ⟦Just like customs inspecting visa stamps in a passport, if an intermediate verification stamp is missing, the system points out exactly which checkpoint was skipped instead of coldly shutting the gate.⟧ Now when an SSL certificate error occurs, the terminal directly analyzes likely causes, such as a server omitting an intermediate certificate, and provides specific remediation instructions. For architectures requiring internal private certificates, you can enable the `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_LOOPED_CROSS_CERT_DROP` environment variable to retain cross-certificates that certify each other in a loop. In addition, network requests will no longer hang indefinitely if compressed data returned by a server is cut off or corrupted midway.

items.original:
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_LOOPED_CROSS_CERT_DROP` to keep system cross-certificates that certify each other in a loop, for servers whose private CA needs one
Fixed some network requests hanging when a compressed response was cut off or corrupted
Improved SSL certificate errors to name the likely causes, among them a server that leaves out an intermediate certificate, and the fix for each

title.zh-TW: 閘道器支援群組共用預算，階層政策與 Bedrock 防護標籤上線
title.en: Gateway Supports Pooled Group Budgets, Layered Policies and Bedrock Guardrail Tagging Released

body.zh-TW: 管理團隊花費與權限時，Claude apps 閘道器有了新選項。花費限制管理 API 的 `pooled_budget` 可設群組每月共用預算，各人仍有個別上限。`managed.policy_mode: layered` 套用所有相符政策，上方覆蓋下方。Bedrock 上游的 `guardrail.input_tagging` 加上提示詞攻擊篩選標籤；`all_messages_and_system` 也替系統提示詞加標籤。請求內每個模型都會檢查 `availableModels`、`deniedModels`、`models`；被封鎖時回傳 400 錯誤並指出對應欄位。強制使用閘道器時，終端機的 `claude auth login` 會顯示其登入入口。Team／Enterprise 從 Anthropic API 取得的受管理設定免確認套用；儲存副本驗證失敗就拒用。
body.en: When managing team spend and permissions, the Claude apps gateway has new options. The `pooled_budget` field on the spend limits admin API can set a monthly shared budget for a group on top of each member's individual limit. Setting `managed.policy_mode: layered` applies all matching policies, merging each over the ones listed below it. On Bedrock upstreams, `guardrail.input_tagging` adds prompt attack filter tags; `all_messages_and_system` also tags the system prompt. Every model named in a request is checked against `availableModels`, `deniedModels`, and `models`; if blocked, a 400 error is returned naming the relevant field. When a gateway is required, running `claude auth login` in a terminal shows the gateway sign-in prompt. Managed settings fetched from the Anthropic API for Team and Enterprise accounts apply without confirmation, and any stored copy that fails verification is rejected.

items.original:
Added pooled group budgets to the Claude apps gateway: one monthly budget that a group's members share, on top of each member's own limit, set with `pooled_budget` on the spend limits admin API
Added `managed.policy_mode: layered` to the Claude apps gateway: every policy that matches a developer applies, each merged over the ones listed below it, not only the first
Added `guardrail.input_tagging` on Claude apps gateway Bedrock upstreams, which wraps prompts in the input tags that an Amazon Bedrock guardrail's prompt attacks filter needs; `all_messages_and_system` also tags the system prompt
Fixed the Claude apps gateway not checking every model a request names against `availableModels`, `deniedModels` and `models`; a request that names a blocked model now gets a 400 naming the field
Fixed `claude auth login` refusing to run where managed settings require a Claude apps gateway; in a terminal it now shows the gateway sign-in
Changed server-managed settings for Team and Enterprise logins: settings fetched from Anthropic's API now apply without an approval prompt, and a stored copy that doesn't verify is refused

title.zh-TW: Opus 4.8 快速模式排定退場，三個模型別名修復自動備援
title.en: Opus 4.8 Fast Mode Slated for Deprecation, Three Model Aliases Restore Fallback

body.zh-TW: 當你在多個雲端平台切換不同版本的 Claude 模型，版本遷移與容錯機制有了具體指引。Opus 4.8 快速模式自 2026 年 10 月 30 日起棄用，將於 11 月 30 日移除；移除後的快速模式請求會報錯，不會回退標準版，需遷移至 Opus 5.5 才能保有加速。在 Vertex AI 與 Amazon Bedrock 上，`sonnet`、`opus`、`haiku` 這三個模型別名，若最新版尚未向帳號或區域開放，會切換至相容舊版提供備援，不再於工作階段中途報錯。若用 `/model <id>` 輸入此版本未辨識的型號，也會主動跳出警告，提醒自動壓縮將預設採用 200K 的上下文視窗容量，也就是可容納的對話量。
body.en: When switching between different Claude model versions across multiple cloud platforms, version migration and fault tolerance now have clear guidance. Fast mode for Opus 4.8 has been deprecated as of October 30, 2026, and will be removed on November 30, 2026; once removed, fast mode requests will return an error rather than falling back to standard Opus 4.8, requiring migration to Opus 5.5 to maintain speedups. On Vertex AI and Amazon Bedrock, the `sonnet`, `opus`, and `haiku` model aliases now switch to a compatible older version to provide fallback if the newest release is not yet available to your account or region, rather than failing mid-session. Entering an unrecognized model with `/model <id>` now triggers a warning that auto-compact will assume a 200K context window (the conversation volume it can hold).

items.original:
Deprecated fast mode for Opus 4.8 as of October 30, 2026; it will be removed on November 30, 2026. After removal, fast mode requests on Opus 4.8 return an error and do not fall back to standard Opus 4.8. Migrate to Opus 5.5 to keep the speedup
Fixed `sonnet`, `opus` and `haiku` on Vertex AI and Amazon Bedrock showing an error mid-session instead of switching to an older model when the newest is not yet available to the account or region
Fixed `/model <id>` not warning when the model isn't recognized by this version and auto-compact will assume a 200K context window

title.zh-TW: 子代理可設定預設運算力度，支援關閉深度思考關鍵字
title.en: Subagents Support Default Effort Settings, Deep Thinking Keyword Can Be Disabled

body.zh-TW: 當你指派背景子代理分頭調查程式庫，任務的思考深度與模型繼承現在能精細掌控。如果團隊不想觸發額外的高強度推論，可透過環境變數 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRATHINK` 直接停用 `ultrathink` 關鍵字。針對後台衍生出的子代理（處理專案分支任務的助手），只有在其他來源都未指定運算力度時，才會使用 `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT`，取代預設繼承主工作階段力度的行為。繼承了上層子代理專屬模型的助手，在被背景通知或新訊息喚醒後，也能持續鎖定指定模型，不會意外跳回主對話模型。
body.en: When dispatching background subagents (helpers that handle branching project tasks) to investigate a codebase, thinking depth and model inheritance can now be finely controlled. If a team prefers not to trigger extra high-intensity reasoning, the `ultrathink` keyword can be disabled directly via the `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRATHINK` environment variable. For subagents spawned in the background, `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT` is used only when no other source specifies an effort level, replacing the default behavior of inheriting the main session's effort. Helpers that inherit a parent subagent's dedicated model will also stay locked to that assigned model after being awakened by a background notification or new message, rather than unexpectedly reverting to the main conversation model.

items.original:
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRATHINK`, which turns the `ultrathink` keyword off
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT` to set the effort level subagents run at when nothing else names one, instead of inheriting the session's
Fixed sub-agents that inherited a parent sub-agent's model moving to the main model when a background job or message woke them

title.zh-TW: 自架執行器與外掛環境修復，改善 SDK 與產物規則載入
title.en: Fixes for self-hosted runners and plugin environments, with improved SDK and Artifact rule loading

body.zh-TW: 自行架設執行環境或撰寫外掛整合時，跨機器狀態與規則顯示不再莫名出錯。自架執行器的工作階段換機後，MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器開關狀態不再遺失；按下停止並替換程序後，也不再答覆工作中傳入的舊訊息。外掛的憑證環境變數設為 `1` 等開關值時，`headersHelper` 腳本收到的 `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` 與伺服器網址不再損毀。SDK（軟體開發工具包）的 `register_repo_root` 請求，在 `CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_DIRECTORIES_CLAUDE_MD=1` 下能載入工作目錄外的 `CLAUDE.md`。產物工具不再把 `self` 自身層級的資料庫存取規則顯示為問號；拒絕會移除這些規則的重新發布時，也會引用這些規則。
body.en: When hosting your own execution environments or writing plugin integrations, cross-machine state and rule displays no longer encounter unexplained errors. After a self-hosted runner session moves to a new machine, the on/off switch state of an MCP (a protocol that connects AI to external tools) server is no longer lost. After pressing Stop and replacing the process, it also no longer answers old messages sent while Claude was working. When a plugin credential environment variable is set to a switch value such as `1`, the `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` and server URL received by `headersHelper` scripts are no longer corrupted. With `CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_DIRECTORIES_CLAUDE_MD=1`, the SDK (software development kit) `register_repo_root` request can now load `CLAUDE.md` from outside the working directory. The Artifact tool no longer displays artifact database access rules at the `self` level as question marks, and now quotes those rules back when refusing a republish that would drop them.

items.original:
Fixed plugin MCP `headersHelper` scripts receiving a corrupted `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` and server URL when a credential-named environment variable was set to a switch value such as `1`
Fixed the SDK `register_repo_root` control request not loading the CLAUDE.md of a directory outside the working directory (with `CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_DIRECTORIES_CLAUDE_MD=1`)
Fixed the Artifact tool showing `?` for artifact database access rules at the `self` level, and not quoting those rules back when it refuses a republish that would drop them
Self-hosted runner: Fixed a message sent while Claude was working being answered after a Stop, once the session's process had been replaced
Self-hosted runner: Fixed an MCP server's on/off switch sometimes being lost when a session moved to a new machine

title.zh-TW: 提示詞輸入清理不可見字元，介面提示與問卷送出機制修正
title.en: Invisible character cleaning in prompt input, with fixes for interface hints and survey submissions

body.zh-TW: 日常在命令列輸入提問與檢視提示時，多處影響打字節奏的介面細節得到了改善。以前從網頁複製文字若夾帶不可見字元，常需連按兩次 Enter 才能送出；現在普通提問第一次按下就會清除這些字元並發送，指令仍保留審查確認步驟。語音輸入提示不再於單一工作階段內耗盡三次顯示額度，未綁定按住說話的熱鍵時，也不再出現空白鍵帽。在窄視窗終端機初次啟動時，安全說明與終端機設定說明都不再漏字。若對話尚在儲存時執行過 `/clear` 清除或 `/resume` 接續指令，還原對話時也能恢復原本的任務計畫。企業問卷輸入 `1` 或 `0` 後，不再因短暫停頓就送出，必須按 Enter 才會確認。
body.en: When entering prompts and viewing hints in daily command-line use, multiple interface details that affect typing rhythm have been improved. Previously, copying text from web pages that contained invisible characters often required pressing Enter twice to send. Plain prompts now clean these characters and send on the first Enter press, while commands still retain the review confirmation step. The voice input hint no longer uses up its quota of three showings in a single session, and an empty keycap no longer appears when push-to-talk is unbound. During first-run startup in narrow terminal windows, security notes and terminal setup explanations no longer drop words. If `/clear` or `/resume` was run while a conversation was still being saved, resuming the conversation now also restores the original task plan. After typing `1` or `0` in the Enterprise survey, answers are no longer submitted due to a short pause, and now require pressing Enter to confirm.

items.original:
Fixed prompts containing invisible characters needing a second Enter to send; plain prompts now send cleaned on the first Enter, and commands still wait for review
Fixed the "hold space to speak" hint using up its three showings in one session, and showing an empty key when push-to-talk is unbound
Fixed a rare case where resuming a conversation did not restore its plan, when `/clear` or `/resume` had been run while part of that conversation was still being saved
Fixed first-run setup dropping words from the security notes and the terminal-setup explanation in narrow terminals
Fixed the Enterprise survey card taking a typed 1 or 0 after a short pause; a typed answer now needs Enter

title.zh-TW: 受限工作階段不再上傳目錄外檔案，比對與搜尋效能改善
title.en: Restricted sessions no longer upload files outside directories, with diff and search performance improvements

body.zh-TW: 當你在大型專案中比對程式碼變更或搜尋檔案，檔案上傳範圍與回應速度更為可靠。⟦恰似廠區門禁嚴格核對出入清單，即使持有特殊通行證，非指定作業區的機密文件一律禁止攜出大門。⟧以往在 `--restricted` 受限工作階段中，即使工作目錄外的檔案有 Read 讀取允許規則涵蓋，仍不該被上傳；現在已修好這項上傳限制。在大型儲存庫輸入 `/diff` 查看差異時，每次重新整理通常少執行一個掃描整個儲存庫的 Git 命令，並在 Git 反應變慢時自動拉開重新整理間隔。針對 Windows 使用者，Grep 與 Glob 搜尋工具在觸發逾時停止時，也不會再因搜尋行程未順利結束而無止境卡住畫面。
body.en: When comparing code changes or searching files across large projects, file upload scope and responsiveness are now more reliable. ⟦A factory security checkpoint strictly checks the entry and exit list: even with a special pass, confidential documents outside designated work areas are strictly barred from being carried out the gate.⟧ Previously in `--restricted` sessions, files outside working directories were not supposed to be uploaded even when covered by a Read allow rule. This upload restriction has now been fixed. When entering `/diff` in large repositories to inspect changes, each refresh usually runs one fewer full-repository Git command, and refresh intervals are automatically spaced out when Git responds slowly. For Windows users, Grep and Glob search tools no longer freeze the screen indefinitely when a search process is killed at timeout but fails to exit cleanly.

items.original:
Fixed `--restricted` sessions uploading files from outside the working directories when a Read allow rule covered them
Fixed Grep and Glob never returning when the search process is killed at the timeout but does not exit, seen on Windows
Improved `/diff` on large repositories: each refresh usually runs one fewer full-repository git command, and refreshes are spaced out when git is slow

Added `guardrail_trace` to Claude apps gateway Bedrock upstreams, to log which Amazon Bedrock guardrail filter fired on a request, without the matched text

items.original: Added `permissions.blockWritesOutsideWorkingDirectories`: Write, Edit and NotebookEdit refuse paths outside the working directories in every permission mode

title.zh-TW: 應用程式閘道支援群組分流，完善防護紀錄與逾時修復
title.en: Application Gateways Support Group Routing, Refined Guardrail Logging, and Timeout Fixes

body.zh-TW: 企業內部透過應用程式閘道派發請求時，往往需要依據開發團隊的身分劃分不同線路。現在閘道上游新增了選填群組名單，只有在身分提供者群組內的開發者才會被導向指定上游，發生備援切換時也維持相同規則。針對 Amazon Bedrock 上游新增了防護追蹤設定，會記錄觸發了哪一項安全過濾機制而不會印出比對文字。此外修正了 Vertex 上游遇到 Google 憑證端點無回應而卡住數分鐘的問題，過期金鑰的啟動警告文字也一併修正。⟦彷彿機場海關依護照類別分流通道，指定身分的旅客才能走專屬查驗線，遇到轉機換櫃也維持相同安檢標準。⟧
body.en: When routing requests through an application gateway inside an enterprise, teams often need to divide routes based on developer identities. Gateway upstreams now add an optional group list so only developers in identity provider groups are directed to the designated upstream, maintaining the same rule during failover. For Amazon Bedrock upstreams, a new guardrail trace setting logs which safety filter fired without printing the matched text. In addition, an issue where a Vertex upstream hung for minutes when a Google credential endpoint was unresponsive has been fixed, and the startup warning message for expired keys was also corrected. ⟦Like airport customs dividing lanes by passport category, only travelers with designated identities can use the dedicated inspection lane, and the same security standards are maintained when switching transfer counters.⟧

items.original:
Added an optional `groups` list to Claude apps gateway upstreams: only developers in the listed IdP groups are sent to that upstream, on failover too
Added `guardrail_trace` to Claude apps gateway Bedrock upstreams, to log which Amazon Bedrock guardrail filter fired on a request, without the matched text
Fixed a Claude apps gateway Vertex upstream hanging for minutes when a Google token endpoint accepts the connection and never answers
Fixed the Claude apps gateway's start-up warning for a deprecated Claude Desktop key that it still serves as written saying "stops being accepted" after the key's end date

title.zh-TW: 閒置對話自動整理摘要，支援主流雲端平台與掛鉤防護
title.en: Automatic Summaries for Idle Conversations, Major Cloud Platform Support, and Hook Safeguards

body.zh-TW: 把長對話擱置在編輯器一旁後，重新提問時往往會因為超出長度而耗費額外的處理資源。VS Code 與 Claude Desktop 新增了閒置壓縮機制。只要對話超過 20 萬個 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）且處於閒置，系統便會預先產出摘要。⟦宛若會計事務所利用午休裝訂憑證，以前案卷散落會拖慢查帳，現在趁離席空檔將過期單據濃縮成總表，回到座位便能直接對帳。⟧一旦快取（cache，把算過的結果暫存起來直接用）過期，下一次送出訊息就會直接使用這份摘要。這項機制現在也開放給關閉遙測的使用者，以及開啟一小時快取的 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 與各大閘道。壓縮前掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時會觸發的小程式）輸出若過大，內容會硬性截斷在 10,000 字元以內，避免對話壓縮失敗。
body.en: Leaving long conversations sitting aside in an editor often consumes extra processing resources due to excessive length when asking follow-up questions. VS Code and Claude Desktop have added an idle compaction mechanism. Whenever a conversation exceeds 200,000 tokens (text units processed and billed by AI) and sits idle, the system generates a summary in advance. ⟦Imagine an accounting firm binding vouchers during lunch break: scattered case files previously slowed down audits, but now outdated receipts are condensed into summary sheets during breaks away from desks, letting accountants reconcile accounts immediately upon returning.⟧ Once the cache expires, your next message will directly use this summary. This mechanism is now also available for users with telemetry turned off, as well as Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, and major gateways with one-hour caching enabled. If output from pre-compact hooks (small programs triggered by specific events) is too large, the content is strictly truncated to 10,000 characters to prevent compaction failures.

items.original:
Added idle compaction to VS Code and Claude Desktop's Code tab: a 200K+ token conversation left idle is summarized, and the summary is used on your next message if the prompt cache has expired
Fixed a PreCompact hook with very large output making compaction fail or repeat; each hook's output is now cut at 10,000 characters
Changed idle compaction to also run for subscribers with telemetry turned off, and on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and LLM gateways once the one-hour prompt cache is on

title.zh-TW: 調適組織思考強度上限，遇部署缺漏自動切換相容模型
title.en: Adapting to Organization Effort Caps and Auto-Switching to Compatible Models on Missing Deployments

body.zh-TW: 團隊若對模型存取設有限制，工作階段常因為參數超標或缺少部署而突然中斷。若組織管理員限制了思考強度上限，現在遇到參數無效時會自動調降強度、重新嘗試並告知使用等級。在 Microsoft Foundry 缺少預設模型部署時，會自動切換至同系列的舊版模型作為備援。受管設定釘選模型後，Bedrock 與 Vertex 不會再於每次啟動時跳出升級提示。即使個人外掛程式清單損壞，也不再阻擋模型切換。此外，復原或繼續工作階段時會保留原本未知的自訂模型名稱，而遇到要求被標記時，若設定允許也會嘗試改用其他可用模型重送。以前在嚴格受管的環境下切換或復原模型容易直接報錯卡死，現在系統會自主尋找相容配置維持對話順暢。
body.en: When teams place restrictions on model access, sessions often abruptly halt due to parameter limits or missing deployments. If an organization administrator caps thinking effort, invalid parameters now automatically trigger a lower effort level, a retry, and a notice stating the level used. When Microsoft Foundry lacks a deployment for the default model, the system automatically falls back to an older model in the same family. After managed settings pin a model, Bedrock and Vertex will no longer display upgrade prompts on every startup. Even if a personal plugin manifest is broken, model switching is no longer blocked. In addition, restoring or resuming a session preserves unrecognized custom model names, and flagged requests will attempt to retry on another available model if settings permit. Where switching or resuming models in strictly managed environments previously threw errors and halted, the system now autonomously finds compatible configurations to keep conversations flowing smoothly.

items.original:
Fixed sessions failing turn after turn with "Invalid effort level" when an organization's admin caps a model's effort: Claude Code now lowers the effort, retries, and says which level it uses
Fixed Microsoft Foundry sessions failing when the resource has no deployment for the default Sonnet, Opus or Haiku model: Claude Code now falls back to an older model of that family
Fixed model switching being refused on machines with managed plugin settings when one of your own `--plugin-dir` or `--plugin-url` plugins had a broken manifest or failed to download
Fixed the Bedrock and Vertex model upgrade offer coming back at every start when managed settings pin the model
Fixed `--resume`, and rewinding past a switch to another model after a refusal, moving a session on a model name Claude Code doesn't recognize to a different model
Changed flagged requests to retry on another model, not end in a refusal, when `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL`, `availableModels` or `deniedModels` leaves only an older Opus model, or none

title.zh-TW: 修正命令列非零結束代碼，強化憑證驗證與背景執行
title.en: Command-Line Non-Zero Exit Code Fix, Certificate Verification, and Background Execution

body.zh-TW: 在腳本或自動化管線中呼叫指令列工具時，若錯誤沒有正確回報，常會導致除錯方向徹底偏差。現在使用 `claude -p` 啟動失敗時，會印出錯誤原因並以結束代碼 1 離開，不再靜默回傳成功。當系統憑證庫（certificate store，存放根憑證的地方）中更新後的根憑證由前一版根憑證交叉簽署時，TLS 連線不再因找不到簽發者而中斷。背景常駐程式啟動失敗時，也不再誤報成執行檔已被刪除。另外，包含指令輸出標籤的提示能正確向本機回應，而將 `FORCE_HYPERLINK` 設為 `false`、`no` 或 `off` 都會關閉終端機超連結。
body.en: When calling command-line tools in scripts or automated pipelines, failing to report errors correctly often misguides debugging efforts. When startup fails with `claude -p`, the tool now prints the error cause and exits with code 1 instead of silently returning success. When a renewed root certificate in the system certificate store (a repository holding root certificates) is cross-signed by its predecessor, TLS connections no longer fail due to missing issuers. Background daemon startup failures are also no longer misreported as deleted binaries. Additionally, prompts containing command output tags acknowledge correctly to the local host, and setting `FORCE_HYPERLINK` to `false`, `no`, or `off` turns off terminal hyperlinks.

items.original:
Fixed `claude -p` exiting with code 0 and no output when startup failed; it now prints the error and exits 1
Fixed TLS connections failing with `UNABLE_TO_GET_ISSUER_CERT` when the system certificate store holds a renewed root certificate that is cross-signed with its predecessor
Fixed prompts containing tags such as `<bash-stdout>` or `<local-command-stdout>` not being acknowledged to a local stream-json host
Fixed background sessions that fail to start being reported as a deleted daemon binary when the binary is still on disk
Changed `FORCE_HYPERLINK=false` (also `no` and `off`) to turn hyperlinks off instead of on

title.zh-TW: 改善長篇文件與多圖處理，長度超標主動提示未讀範圍
title.en: Handling Long Documents and Multiple Images with Proactive Notices for Unread Content

body.zh-TW: 對話中一旦傳送大量截圖或長篇文件，輸入內容過大常會讓遠端工具無聲無息地遺漏資訊。現在在 Bedrock 工作階段中堆積過多圖片時，執行壓縮會主動移除舊圖片來順利縮減長度，不再每次回覆都卡在輸入過長的錯誤。在遠端 Linux 主機透過 SSH 連線時，若嘗試直接貼上圖片，提示框會明確指引你將檔案複製到主機並貼上路徑，不再毫無反應。⟦恰似快遞收發中心處理超重包裹，以前遇到箱子塞不下便直接拒收或偷偷扣件，現在會主動分裝打包並在清單上清楚註明未裝入的項目。⟧在 Cowork 雲端工作階段中使用網頁抓取工具讀取 PDF 時，若文字內容超出 10 萬字元，會主動說明有多少內容未被讀取以及如何接續查閱。
body.en: Once conversations receive large numbers of screenshots or long documents, oversized inputs often cause remote tools to silently miss information. When too many images accumulate in Bedrock sessions, compacting now actively removes older images to reduce length smoothly, rather than getting stuck on input-too-long errors on every turn. When connecting via SSH to a remote Linux host, attempting to paste an image directly now prompts you to copy the file over and paste its path instead of doing nothing silently. ⟦Just as a courier dispatch center handles overweight packages, where previously overfilled boxes were rejected outright or items were quietly withheld, staff now proactively repack shipments into separate parcels and clearly note unincluded items on the manifest.⟧ When using web fetching tools to read PDFs in Cowork cloud sessions, if text exceeds 100,000 characters, the tool proactively explains how much content was unread and how to continue reading.

items.original:
Fixed Bedrock sessions with many images failing every turn and `/compact` with "400 Input is too long." instead of removing older images and compacting
Fixed pasting an image over SSH to a Linux machine doing nothing silently; the prompt now says to copy the file over and paste its path
Fixed WebFetch in Cowork cloud sessions silently dropping a PDF's text past 100,000 characters; it now says how much was unread and where to read on

title.zh-TW: 相容企業閘道轉發規則，記住退避設定並正確認知自訂模型
title.en: Enterprise Gateway Forwarding Compatibility, Backoff Settings, and Custom Model Recognition

body.zh-TW: 許多團隊透過自建閘道轉發請求，常會因為轉發器不支援部分測試標頭而導致連線失敗。若閘道無法處理工具搜尋中的參考區塊，工作階段會自動略過該區塊重送一次並記住這項偏好，避免反覆被拒。當雲端提供者或閘道明確拒絕特定的測試標頭時，也會自動剔除該標頭並重新發送請求。⟦比照國際包裹在轉運站通關，遇到查驗機讀取不到特殊條碼時，轉運員會撕去附加標籤重新過磅，並在紀錄卡記下該站點的清關慣例。⟧此外，針對名稱中帶有小數點的自訂模型（例如 `claude-opus-4.8`），也不會再誤判為舊型號，能套用正確的上下文視窗大小、輸出長度與計費設定。
body.en: Many teams route requests through custom gateways, where forwarders lacking support for certain beta headers often cause connection failures. If a gateway cannot process reference blocks in tool searches, the session automatically retries once without that block and remembers this preference to avoid repeated rejections. When a cloud provider or gateway explicitly rejects specific beta headers, the request is automatically resent with the header removed. ⟦Consider international packages clearing transit stations: when scanners fail to read special barcodes, handlers strip auxiliary labels to reweigh parcels and record the station's clearance conventions on the log card.⟧ Furthermore, custom models with dots in their names (such as `claude-opus-4.8`) are no longer misidentified as older models, correctly applying context window sizes, output limits, and billing configurations.

items.original:
Fixed repeated refused requests behind a gateway that doesn't accept tool search's `tool_reference` blocks: the request is sent again once without tool search, and the session remembers
Fixed requests failing when a gateway or cloud provider refuses one of Claude Code's beta headers by name: the request is sent again without it
Fixed model IDs spelled with a dot behind an LLM gateway, such as `claude-opus-4.8`, being treated as an older model with the wrong context window, output limit, effort, thinking mode and cost

title.zh-TW: 擴充工具憑證過期自動轉為訪客，加速查詢上萬工具
title.en: Auto-Downgrade to Guest on Expired Tool Credentials and Faster Lookups for Thousands of Tools

body.zh-TW: 專案若串接了大量外部擴充套件，過期的登入憑證常會讓原本公開可用的功能無法調用。現在即使 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器儲存的登入狀態失效，只要該伺服器支援免登入，就會自動以訪客身分繼續運作，不再卡在需要身分驗證的錯誤提示。在 SSH 連線導致鑰匙圈鎖定而無法移除憑證時，執行 `claude mcp logout` 不會再虛報登出成功。⟦跟參觀開放展覽館一樣，以前會員卡過期就連大門都不准進，現在驗證失效時會引導你換發一般訪客手環，照樣能瀏覽常設展區。⟧此外，當工作階段掛載上萬個擴充工具時，輸入 `/context` 檢查環境的載入速度顯著提升。
body.en: When projects connect many external extensions, expired login credentials often prevent publicly available functions from being invoked. Now, even if stored sign-ins on MCP (a protocol connecting AI to external tools) servers stop working, as long as the server works without sign-in, it will automatically operate signed out instead of halting on authentication errors. When a locked keychain prevents credentials from being removed during SSH connections, running `claude mcp logout` no longer falsely reports success. ⟦Much like visiting an open exhibition hall, where an expired membership card previously barred entry at the front doors, guests with invalid credentials are now issued visitor wristbands to view the permanent exhibits.⟧ In addition, when a session mounts ten thousand or more extension tools, typing `/context` to inspect the environment is significantly faster.

items.original:
Fixed MCP servers that also work without sign-in showing "needs authentication" after their stored sign-in stopped working; they are now used signed out
Fixed `claude mcp logout` reporting success when the MCP sign-in was not removed, for example while the macOS keychain is locked over SSH
Improved `/context` speed in sessions with ten thousand or more MCP tools

title.zh-TW: 嚴格執行工作區信任檢查，修改組織託管設定主動確認
title.en: Strict Workspace Trust Checks and Required Confirmation for Modifying Managed Settings

body.zh-TW: 自動化整合流程或團隊協作中，若工具隨意讀取不受信任的程式碼，可能帶來嚴重的資安威脅。在帶有終端機的持續整合環境中，若環境變數偵測到 `CI`，執行審查或遠端操控時只要目錄未獲信任便會立刻中止，不再跳出詢問提示。在終端機輸入 `/ultrareview` 時，也會在執行 Git 指令前先確認工作區是否獲得信任。⟦猶如自動化無人哨所執勤，偵測到非授權訪客時直接拉下閘門，而遇到維修總部機密控制台時也必須先核驗操作員密碼。⟧此外，當檔案工具嘗試修改本機快取的組織伺服器託管設定時，必須先獲得你的確認同意，比照一般個人設定檔的嚴格標準處理。
body.en: In automated integration workflows or team collaborations, tools reading untrusted code without boundaries can pose severe security threats. In continuous integration environments with a terminal, when `CI` is detected in environment variables, running reviews or remote control will immediately abort if a directory is untrusted, instead of prompting for confirmation. Typing `/ultrareview` in the terminal also verifies workspace trust before executing Git commands. ⟦Think of an automated guard post on duty: upon detecting unauthorized visitors it immediately drops the gate, and operator passwords must first be verified before servicing a confidential headquarters console.⟧ In addition, when file tools attempt to modify the locally cached copy of an organization's server-managed settings, they must first obtain your confirmation, following the strict standards applied to personal configuration files.

items.original:
Fixed `claude ultrareview` and `claude remote-control` asking the workspace trust question in a CI job that has a terminal; with `CI` set they now refuse an untrusted folder at once
Changed Claude's file tools to ask before editing the local copy of your organization's server-managed settings, as they do for your settings files
Changed `/ultrareview` to check workspace trust before it runs git, as `claude ultrareview` does

title.zh-TW: 強化企業受管原則套用，避免無網路時脫離安全政策
title.en: Strengthening Managed Enterprise Policies to Prevent Dropping Security Rules While Offline

body.zh-TW: 管理者為內部成員配置統一的安全原則時，設定不該因為離線或客戶端差異而失效。現在管理者在託管設定中指定的憑證信任原則，會確實套用至 Claude Desktop 的工作階段中。設定了強制遠端重新整理時，即便本機快取過期且無法連上伺服器，也不會再允許工作階段在無防護狀態下啟動。透過 `--setting-sources` 明確排除的設定檔，其內部的自動模式規則與授權紀錄會被徹底忽略。另外，當組織政策停用雲端工作階段或遠端操控時，相關提示訊息會徹底隱藏。以前設定過期或切換執行環境容易讓政策出現漏洞，現在各項管理邊界無論連線狀態都能完整生效。
body.en: When administrators configure unified security policies for team members, settings should not fail due to offline states or client differences. Administrator TLS certificate trust rules specified in managed settings now apply reliably to Claude Desktop sessions. When forced remote refresh is configured, sessions will no longer start without protection if the local cache has expired and the server cannot be reached. Configuration files explicitly excluded via `--setting-sources` will have their internal auto mode rules and authorization records completely ignored. Furthermore, when organizational policies disable cloud sessions or remote control, related prompt notices are completely hidden. Where expired settings or switched execution environments previously created policy loopholes, administrative boundaries now remain fully enforced regardless of connection status.

items.original:
Fixed an administrator's TLS trust settings in managed settings not being applied in Claude Desktop sessions
Fixed `forceRemoteSettingsRefresh` set only in remote managed settings no longer applying once the stored copy had expired, which let sessions start without policy when the server could not be reached
Fixed a settings file excluded with `--setting-sources` still supplying some settings, such as auto mode rules and saved permission consents
Fixed the cloud sessions tip and the Remote Control idle notice showing when an organization's policy turns those features off

title.zh-TW: 限制額度重試次數，手動中斷指令能告知已執行的可能
title.en: Limit quota retries and notify when interrupted commands may have run

body.zh-TW: 放手讓排程或背景任務自行運作時，若缺乏適當的剎車機制，系統可能會在耗盡額度時不斷無效空轉。遇到額度上限時，「自動繼續」功能現在嚴格限制在未收到新提示的情況下最多僅能自動重試三次，防止目標檢查或背景任務無限重啟。如果在背景或雲端工作階段關閉了 Ultracode，下次啟動時會確實維持關閉狀態，不會再度擅自開啟。此外，當你在雲端或整合開發環境按下 Esc 或停止按鈕中斷指令時，通知不會只回報指令被拒絕，而是會明確提醒可能已經有部分程式碼實際執行過。以前任務中斷後容易誤判環境狀態或陷入重試迴圈，現在系統既能嚴守重試上限，也能讓助手更真實地掌握指令執行進度。
body.en: When letting scheduled or background tasks run on their own without proper braking mechanisms, the system can spin uselessly after exhausting its quota. At usage limits, the "Continue automatically at usage limit" feature is now strictly capped at three automatic retries without a new prompt, preventing goal check-ins or background tasks from restarting indefinitely. If you turn off Ultracode in background or cloud sessions, it reliably stays off on the next launch rather than turning itself back on. In addition, when you interrupt a command in cloud sessions or the IDE using Esc or the Stop button, notifications no longer just report that the command was declined, but clearly warn that parts of the code may have already executed. While interrupted tasks previously risked misjudging environment states or looping through retries, the system now enforces strict retry limits and gives the assistant a realistic view of command execution progress.

items.original:
Fixed "Continue automatically at usage limit" continuing more than three times without a prompt from you when a task restarted itself between waits (a /goal check-in, a background or scheduled task)
Fixed background and cloud sessions started with Ultracode turning it back on at their next start after it had been switched off
Fixed Claude being told only that a command was declined after you stopped it with Esc or Stop in a cloud session or the IDE; it now also hears that the command may have run

title.zh-TW: 穩定表格即時串流排版，清理對話失敗重試殘留痕跡
title.en: Stabilize streaming table layouts and clean leftover artifacts from failed retries

body.zh-TW: 在終端機瀏覽助手即時生成的長篇回答時，畫面若頻繁跳動或遺留殘缺內容，非常影響閱讀體驗。當工具呼叫解析失敗且最終放棄時，對話中不再保留破裂的回答與重試提示。現在即時串流輸出 Markdown 表格時，未完成的資料行不會再於格狀與直列排版間反覆跳動，超長表格也不會退回成原始管道符號。⟦如同印刷機在高速打樣時校正滾筒，以前未印完的段落會造成排版錯位與溢墨，現在即時上墨整齊劃一，作廢的校樣也會立刻收納乾淨。⟧程式碼區塊開頭的空行不會在引號內消失，按 Ctrl+O 查看對話紀錄時也不會在折疊符號上方冒出多餘空行。另外，在向上捲動狀態下執行復原對話時，全螢幕紀錄不會再停在半截未完成的位置。
body.en: When viewing long assistant responses streamed in the terminal, flickering displays or leftover fragments disrupt the reading experience. When a tool call cannot be parsed and is ultimately abandoned, the conversation no longer retains broken replies and retry prompts. Streaming Markdown tables no longer jitter between grid and stacked layouts on unfinished rows, nor do very long tables fall back to raw pipe characters. ⟦A printing press calibrates its cylinders during high-speed proofing: while incomplete sections previously caused misaligned layouts and ink spills, fresh inking is now crisp and uniform, and scrapped proofs are cleared away immediately.⟧ Blank lines at the start of code blocks no longer vanish inside quotes, and viewing transcripts with Ctrl+O avoids extra blank lines above folding markers. Additionally, restoring a conversation while scrolled up no longer leaves the fullscreen transcript frozen midway through an unfinished view.

items.original:
Fixed the last broken reply and its retry prompts staying in the conversation after Claude gave up on a tool call that could not be parsed
Fixed markdown tables jumping between grid and stacked layouts on half-typed rows while streaming, and long tables falling back to raw pipes
Fixed blank lines at the top of a code block disappearing when the code block opens a quote
Fixed a blank line appearing above some `⎿` rows in the transcript view (Ctrl+O)
Fixed the fullscreen transcript being left mid-conversation after "Restore conversation" in the rewind menu while scrolled up

title.zh-TW: 避免背景比對鎖死 Git，設定垃圾桶上限並降載檔案監聽
title.en: Prevent background diffs from locking Git, cap trash folders, and lighten file watching

body.zh-TW: 頻繁在大型專案中儲存檔案時，背景工具如果過度占用系統資源，很容易干擾日常的版控操作。以前背景自動整理差異時會短暫鎖定 Git 索引，現在不再與你在終端機執行的 Git 指令搶奪鎖定資源。技能與外掛程式的垃圾桶目錄現在設有約 1024 筆的容量上限，且檔案監聽器不再掃描垃圾桶內的廢棄檔案，能減輕磁碟負擔。⟦宛如清潔人員在後台整理備品，不再霸佔主走道的貨物推車，並定期清空廢棄物暫存區，確保前台物流通行無阻。⟧在啟用換行符號轉換的專案中編輯檔案時，不會再因單行修改而將整份檔案誤判為全部變更。在 macOS 上執行搜尋時也改用 C 語言區域設定，避免正規表達式（regex，用符號匹配字串的語法）函式庫在讀取非 UTF-8 檔案時發生記憶體流失。
body.en: When saving files frequently in large projects, background tools that consume excessive system resources can interfere with routine version control. Background diff generation no longer contends for lock resources with Git commands running in your terminal after previously locking the Git index briefly. Trash directories for skills and plugins now have a capacity cap of about 1024 entries, and the file watcher stops scanning discarded files inside trash to lighten disk overhead. ⟦Cleaning staff restock supplies backstage without hogging carts in main corridors and routinely empty disposal bins to ensure front-stage traffic flows unimpeded.⟧ Editing files in projects with newline conversion enabled will no longer misidentify an entire file as modified after a single-line edit. Searches on macOS now switch to the C locale, preventing regex (syntax that matches text patterns with symbols) libraries from leaking memory when reading non-UTF-8 files.

items.original:
Fixed background diff refreshes briefly taking the repository's index lock, which could make a git command run at the same moment fail with "Unable to create '.git/index.lock': File exists"
Fixed the skill file watcher checking every removed skill kept in `~/.claude/skills/.trash`, which added file system load that grew with each removal
Fixed `~/.claude/skills/.trash` and `~/.claude/plugins/.trash` growing without limit: each now holds about 1024 entries, whatever `cleanupPeriodDays` says
Fixed the Bash edit diff listing a whole file as changed when a CRLF file under git's line-ending conversion was re-saved unchanged or had one line edited
macOS: Changed `git grep` in most commands that Claude runs to use the C locale, to avoid a reported memory leak in macOS's regex library on files that aren't valid UTF-8

title.zh-TW: 智慧生成工作階段標題，修復重命名遺失與清單殘留
title.en: Generate session titles automatically, retain renames, and clean resume lists

body.zh-TW: 平時在多個終端機視窗並行處理任務時，清單若無法清楚辨認每個對話名稱，往往會浪費許多翻找時間。現在以特定技能或指令開頭的工作階段，會自動以該指令命名，即使首則提問失敗也不會再永久顯示為未命名。在執行斜線指令時，工作階段選擇清單不會再錯誤抓取說明檔案內容作為標題。在等待權限確認時，透過 `/rename` 設定的名稱會持續保留，方便辨識並列視窗。已刪除的紀錄不再異常重新現身，而面對損毀的紀錄檔時，使用 `--resume` 恢復對話的速度與記憶體表現也顯著提升。以前工作階段清單容易出現空白或錯置的檔名，現在對話命名更加精確，並行作業時不再混淆各個視窗的進度。
body.en: When juggling tasks across multiple terminal windows, session lists that fail to identify conversations clearly waste valuable time searching around. Sessions that start with a specific skill or command are now automatically named after that command, avoiding remaining permanently untitled even if the initial prompt fails. When running slash commands, the session picker no longer mistakenly grabs contents from documentation files as session titles. Names set via `/rename` now persist while waiting for permission confirmations, keeping side-by-side windows easy to distinguish. Deleted transcripts no longer reappear unexpectedly, and restoring conversations with `--resume` offers noticeable improvements in speed and memory usage when handling damaged transcript files. While session lists previously suffered from blank entries or misplaced filenames, conversations are now named accurately so parallel workflows remain clear across windows.

items.original:
Fixed the /resume picker showing the text of CLAUDE.md or CLAUDE.local.md as a session's title when the session only ran slash commands
Fixed a rare case where a deleted session could reappear in the resume list as an almost empty entry
Fixed sessions staying untitled when the first prompt failed (for example on a usage limit) and the conversation continued afterward
Fixed the session name from /rename disappearing while Claude asks for permission or a plan decision, so side-by-side sessions stay identifiable
Improved session auto-titles: a session that starts with a skill or a prompt-based command such as `/security-review` now gets a title from it instead of staying untitled
Improved `--resume` speed and memory use on damaged transcripts

title.zh-TW: 隔離子代理互動範圍，修正按鍵誤觸並釋放背景記憶體
title.en: Isolate subagent interactions, fix keystroke misfires, and release background memory

body.zh-TW: 開啟子代理進行深度除錯或背景研究時，若主畫面與背景工作的控制項交纏在一起，容易誤停正在進行的工作。在子代理檢視畫面中輸入 `/btw`，會依據該子代理的上下文回答，按下 Esc 鍵也不會誤連帶中斷正在背景執行的子代理。全螢幕頂端會正確顯示該子代理實際運行的模型，而非主對話的模型。代理面板的按鍵選取修復了清單變動時誤點其他成員的狀況。在長耗時的無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機視覺介面的執行模式）與軟體開發套件中，主工作階段不再囤積已結束子代理的工具結果，顯著改善記憶體占用。此外，設定選單也補充了如何取消預設開啟代理檢視的說明。以前同時調度多個代理人容易發生按鍵誤判或記憶體膨脹，現在介面權責劃分清楚，長時間協同運算更為可靠。
body.en: Launching subagents for deep debugging or background research can accidentally halt active tasks if controls between the main view and background jobs get tangled. Entering `/btw` from a subagent transcript view now answers using that subagent's context, and pressing Esc no longer mistakenly interrupts a subagent running in the background. The top of the fullscreen view correctly displays the model running that subagent instead of the model from the main conversation. Key selections in the agent panel fix issues where list changes caused actions to target the wrong member. During long runs in headless mode (execution without a terminal visual interface) and software development kits, the main session no longer hoards tool results from finished subagents, noticeably reducing memory footprint. In addition, the configuration menu now includes instructions on how to disable opening the agent view by default. Where coordinating multiple agents once led to mistargeted keystrokes or memory bloat, clear boundaries across the interface make prolonged multi-agent execution reliable.

items.original:
Fixed `/btw` answering from the main conversation when asked from a subagent's open transcript
Fixed x and Enter in the agent panel sometimes acting on the wrong agent when another agent started or finished
Fixed Esc on a command's panel, such as `/btw`, also interrupting the subagent whose transcript is open
Fixed the welcome header in fullscreen mode showing the session's model while viewing a subagent or teammate that runs on a different model
Improved memory use in long headless and SDK turns that run many subagents: the parent session no longer keeps each subagent's tool results until the turn ends
Improved `/config` in agent view to say how to stop agent view opening by default

title.zh-TW: 妥善處理多工作階段憑證鎖定，行動訂閱升級精確引導
title.en: Handle multi-session credential locking smoothly and guide mobile subscription upgrades

body.zh-TW: 本機若同時開啟多個工作階段，或者透過不同管道訂閱方案，帳號驗證一旦衝突便會中斷手邊工作。現在當多個工作階段共用同一個登入設定檔時，即使憑證鎖定正忙碌，也不會再觸發不必要的重複換發手續。對於透過行動應用商店扣款的訂閱方案，輸入 `/upgrade` 不會再開啟瀏覽器強制重新登入，而是直接說明應前往何處變更方案。⟦跟持專案工作證進出管制大樓一樣，同組人員共用憑證不再重複在門口換證，由特殊通路簽約的成員也能獲得正確的續約指引。⟧雲端工作階段遇到帳號存取被拒時，錯誤提示會主動建議執行 `claude auth login` 重新驗證。針對企業行動裝置管理與遠端設定網址不一致的狀況，也優化了儲存憑證的套用行為。
body.en: Running multiple local sessions simultaneously or subscribing through different channels can halt work if account authentication conflicts arise. When several sessions share the same login profile, a busy credentials lock no longer triggers unnecessary duplicate renewal cycles. For subscriptions billed through mobile app stores, entering `/upgrade` no longer opens a browser to force a fresh sign-in, but instead explains directly where to modify your plan. ⟦Colleagues sharing a project badge enter a restricted building without repeatedly re-verifying credentials at the gate, while members signed through special channels receive direct renewal instructions.⟧ When a cloud session encounters an account access refusal, error messages proactively suggest running `claude auth login` to re-authenticate. Stored credential application has also been refined for situations where mobile device management and remote settings disagree on endpoints.

items.original:
Fixed extra sign-in renewals when several sessions share an Anthropic profile login and the credentials lock is busy
Fixed `/upgrade` opening the browser and starting a new login for plans billed through the App Store or Google Play; it now says where to change the plan
Improved the cloud session error shown while a request refused for your claude.ai login is still being retried: it now also suggests `claude auth login`
Improved the behavior of stored claude.ai, Team, and Enterprise logins when MDM and remote settings differ on base URL or `apiKeyHelper`

title.zh-TW: 強化遠端操控連線重試，開啟即時同步真實權限模式
title.en: Strengthen Remote Control retry logic and sync real permission modes on open

body.zh-TW: 透過手機或另一台裝置遠端連線回本機工作時，連線若遇延遲或顯示錯誤狀態，會讓人難以放心授權。現在 `claude remote-control` 啟動工作階段遇到伺服器短暫遲緩時，會採用遞增間隔自動重試註冊，避免連線失敗。切換模型超過 8 秒時，能正常等待最終回覆，不再中途跳出逾時錯誤。客戶端在壓縮對話後不再殘留多餘的摘要提示列，權限模式按鈕更會在連線開啟當下立即顯示真實狀態，不必等到輸入文字才更新。⟦猶如操作遠端無人監控設備，連線不穩時主動拉長間隔重撥，儀表板一連線就精確對齊當前檔位，不再顯示前一次殘留的虛假燈號。⟧此外，當組織關閉遠端操控或推播設定被隱藏時，也不會再跳出推播通知的閒置提醒。
body.en: Connecting remotely to a local machine via mobile phone or another device can make granting permissions uneasy if connections lag or show inaccurate states. When starting a session with `claude remote-control` during momentary server slowdowns, worker registration now automatically retries with increasing intervals to prevent connection failures. Switching models taking over 8 seconds waits normally for final responses without throwing premature timeout errors. Clients no longer retain stray summary prompt rows after compacting conversations, and permission mode buttons immediately display their true state as soon as connections open instead of waiting until text is typed. ⟦Operators running an unmanned remote station back off retry intervals during shaky connections, while the dashboard aligns with current gear on connection instead of displaying stale indicator lights.⟧ Furthermore, idle reminders for push notifications no longer appear when organizations disable remote control or push settings are hidden.

items.original:
Fixed `claude remote-control` sessions that failed to start when the session service was slow for a moment: the worker's registration is now retried with growing waits
Fixed model switches over Remote Control that take over 8 seconds getting a "still pending" error instead of the final result
Fixed Remote Control clients showing a stray "Compacted (ctrl+o to see full summary)" row after /compact
Fixed the tip and idle reminder about push notifications appearing when the push settings in `/config` are hidden or your organization has turned off Remote Control
[Remote Control] Fixed the permission mode button in Remote Control sessions showing the wrong mode until you typed; while your computer is online it now shows the real mode on open

title.zh-TW: 沙盒保護涵蓋分支副本，指令掛鉤支援監視工具過濾
title.en: Extend sandbox coverage to branch copies and filter monitor commands with hooks

body.zh-TW: 在獨立分支中驗證未經測試的腳本時，安全沙盒必須滴水不漏地涵蓋所有衍生的工作環境。現在透過續接參數進入工作樹（worktree，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）時，沙盒防護依然會嚴格套用。設定說明也精準更正為：一次呼叫中的所有指令都必須符合清單，才會在沙盒外執行。監視工具啟動的指令現在能正確觸發 Bash 掛鉤以進行阻擋或確認，掛鉤判斷條件也新增了對監視指令的語法支援。另外，Bash 工具會清除繼承的指令別名與函式，確保查詢指令一律指向正規的系統程式或內建功能。以前在分支副本或特殊工具環境下執行指令容易脫離安全管轄，現在環境隔離更為徹底，避免了自訂別名干擾系統判斷。
body.en: When testing unverified scripts in isolated branches, security sandboxes must thoroughly cover all derivative working environments. Sandbox protections now apply strictly when entering a worktree (a Git feature for running multiple parallel copies of the same project) via resumption flags. Setting descriptions have been clarified to state that every command in a call must match the list to run outside the sandbox. Commands launched by monitoring tools now properly trigger Bash hooks for blocking or prompting, and hook conditional logic adds syntax support for matching monitor commands. In addition, the Bash tool strips inherited command aliases and functions, ensuring lookup commands consistently point to regular system binaries or built-in utilities. Where running commands in branch copies or specialized tool environments once risked escaping security oversight, environmental isolation is now thorough and protects system logic from custom aliases.

items.original:
Fixed the `sandbox.excludedCommands` setting description saying listed commands always run outside the sandbox; it now says every command in a call must match an entry
Fixed sandbox protections not applying to a worktree entered by `claude -p --resume` or `--continue`
Fixed hooks matching Bash not running on shell commands started by the Monitor tool; such hooks can block or ask, but not approve or rewrite those commands
Changed the Bash tool's shell to clear any inherited `which` alias or function and to stop passing exported `which`/`unsetenv` functions to commands, so `which` is the system command or zsh builtin
Changed hook `if` conditions such as `Monitor(tail *)` to match the Monitor tool's shell commands as `Bash(tail *)` matches Bash's

title.zh-TW: 自動模式清楚標示被攔截指令，未完成安檢不誤報封鎖
title.en: Label blocked commands clearly in auto mode and avoid false blockage reports

body.zh-TW: 讓工具在自動模式下自主執行任務時，若遇到指令被攔截，清楚明瞭的狀態提示才能幫助你快速排除障礙。以前被規則或掛鉤阻擋的指令，容易在收折清單中看起來像已經執行完畢，現在會明確標示未曾運行。當安全檢查未給出明確結論時，自動模式不會再直接判定為封鎖並塞入權限清單中。在指令被阻擋時，提示訊息會清楚點名該指令，說明助手可能會重試且會再次檢查，並引導你輸入 `/permissions` 進行審查。在 Cowork 雲端環境中，掛鉤放行外部工具時改為由分類器或確認視窗接手把關，確保審查更嚴謹。以前指令被阻擋時介面資訊容易混淆，現在攔截狀態一目了然，使用者能精確掌握每道指令的審查結果。
body.en: When allowing tools to run tasks autonomously in auto mode, clear status indications help you troubleshoot roadblocks quickly whenever commands get intercepted. Commands blocked by rules or hooks previously looked like they had finished executing inside collapsed lists, but are now clearly labeled as not having run. When safety checks reach no definitive conclusion, auto mode no longer assumes calls are blocked and stops inserting them into permission lists. When a command is blocked, prompt messages explicitly name the command, explain that the assistant may retry and check again, and direct you to enter `/permissions` to review. In Cowork cloud environments, when hooks approve external tools, classifiers or confirmation prompts now take over the final decision to ensure stricter review. While blocked command statuses previously caused confusion, interception states are now immediately clear, giving users precise insight into review outcomes for every command.

items.original:
Fixed shell and MCP calls that auto mode, a deny rule or a PreToolUse hook blocked, or that otherwise did not run, reading as if they ran in a collapsed tool group
Fixed auto mode reporting a call as blocked, and listing it in `/permissions`, when its safety check gave no verdict
Improved auto mode's blocked calls: messages name the command, say Claude may retry and auto mode checks again, and point to `/permissions` to review
Changed auto mode in Cowork cloud sessions: a hook's allow of an MCP tool call now counts as no answer, so the classifier or a permission prompt decides

title.zh-TW: 雲端工作階段腳本報錯仍可啟動，排版呈現環境與儲存庫
title.en: Allow cloud sessions to launch on script errors and format environments into tables

body.zh-TW: 透過雲端服務委託任務時，若初始化流程或分支同步稍有異常，工作階段便可能直接中斷而無法檢視。現在即使初始設定腳本回傳錯誤代碼，來自網頁、電腦或行動裝置的雲端工作階段依然能正常開啟以供除錯。復原對話時，不會再因為背景單元先前剛接收檔案就無故觸發非預期的模型呼叫。切換分支時，不會再因其他工作樹的推送而每輪誤報有未提交的變更。權限模式切換被拒絕時，選單會如實顯示目前生效的模式。⟦好比進入工程實驗艙，即使前置通風檢測有警告燈號，艙門仍准許開啟讓工程師進場維修，儀表板也將繁雜的數據排成清楚的表格。⟧此外，紀錄中的重命名會直接顯示新名稱，儲存庫與環境清單也改以整齊表格呈現，取代原本單行混亂的格式。
body.en: When delegating tasks via cloud services, minor glitches during initialization or branch synchronization could previously terminate sessions prematurely and prevent inspection. Cloud sessions from web, desktop, or mobile devices now launch normally for debugging even if setup scripts return error codes. Resuming conversations no longer triggers unexpected model calls simply because a background worker recently received files. Switching branches avoids reporting uncommitted changes on every turn due to pushes from other worktrees. When permission mode switches are declined, the menu faithfully reflects the mode currently in effect. ⟦Technicians entering an engineering test chamber can still step inside for repairs even if pre-check ventilation triggers a warning light, while the console organizes complex metrics into neat tables.⟧ Additionally, rename entries in transcripts display new titles directly, and repository and environment listings appear in tidy tables instead of cluttered single lines.

items.original:
Fixed a resumed claude.ai cloud session making a model call nobody asked for when the previous worker stopped just after receiving a new chat's files
[Cloud sessions] Fixed cloud sessions reporting uncommitted changes every turn after Claude moved a branch to a commit it had pushed from another worktree
[Cloud sessions] Fixed the permission mode picker staying on Auto after a running cloud or Remote Control session refused the switch; it now shows the mode in use and tells you
[Cloud sessions] Improved cloud session transcripts: a rename row now names the new title, and repository and environment lists show as a table instead of one line of JSON
[Cloud sessions] Changed cloud sessions from the web, desktop and mobile apps to start even when a setup script exits with an error, instead of failing to start

title.zh-TW: 修正 Vim 模式行尾越界，精準貼上整行並保留換行符號
title.en: Fix Vim mode overshooting line ends, paste whole lines accurately, and preserve line breaks

body.zh-TW: 習慣使用 Vim 快捷鍵編輯輸入框內容時，游標動作若超出預期邊界，常常會不小心刪改到下一行的文字。現在使用 `dw`、`dW`、`yw` 與 `yW` 等指令時，動作範圍會嚴格受限在目前行內，不再一路穿透到下一行。按 `w` 或 `W` 往前移動時，遇到空白行會正常停住。使用文字物件 `aw` 與 `iw` 選取單字時，不會再意外吞掉行尾的換行符號。另外，在字元選取模式下按 `p` 貼上時，系統會如實辨識剪貼簿內是整行還是局部字元，精準還原整行內容。以前在終端機內以 Vim 模式編輯指令容易誤刪鄰近行，現在字詞邊界與跨行貼上都能完美遵循標準編輯規範。
body.en: When using Vim shortcuts to edit prompt input, cursor actions that exceed expected boundaries often accidentally modify text on the next line. Commands such as `dw`, `dW`, `yw`, and `yW` are now strictly confined to the current line instead of carrying past the end of the line. Moving forward with `w` or `W` stops properly on empty lines. Selecting words with text objects `aw` and `iw` no longer accidentally absorbs trailing line breaks at the end of the line. In addition, pressing `p` to paste over a character selection faithfully recognizes whether the clipboard holds whole lines or partial text, accurately restoring full lines. While editing commands in Vim mode inside the terminal previously risked accidentally deleting neighboring lines, word boundaries and multi-line pasting now adhere cleanly to standard editing conventions.

items.original:
Fixed vim mode `dw`, `dW`, `yw` and `yW` carrying on past the end of the line, and made `w` and `W` stop on empty lines
Fixed vim mode `p` over a character selection ignoring whether the yanked text was whole lines
Fixed vim mode `aw` and `iw` taking the line break at the end of a line

title.zh-TW: 修復輸入框貼上遺失，歷史搜尋支援收折的長文字標籤
title.en: Fix lost pastes in prompts and support collapsed long text pills in history search

body.zh-TW: 遇到要在提示列貼上長篇日誌或拖入檔案路徑的場合，內容若意外消失，就必須回頭重新複製操作。現在在提問互動對話框中，即使焦點沒有停留在其他選項欄位，直接貼上文字或拖入檔案也不會再遺失內容。當游標選取了底部提示列中的特定項目時，貼上的文字也能如實送入輸入框。按下方向鍵往下瀏覽時，不會再選到被說明選單或指令清單遮蔽的隱藏項目。⟦宛如在快捷便條紙夾中查閱歸檔，以前收進封套的長篇草稿在檢索時無法被搜尋，現在不僅隨手夾入不會遺漏，抽查關鍵字時也能透視封套內容。⟧此外，在終端機按 Ctrl+R 搜尋歷史輸入時，也能直接搜尋被折疊在貼上文字標籤內部的詳細內容。
body.en: When pasting long logs or dragging file paths into the prompt, having content vanish forces you to start over and copy again. In Claude's question dialog, pasting text or dragging files directly no longer loses content even when focus is not on the "Other" row. Pasted text is also reliably routed to the input box when a specific row in the prompt footer is selected. Pressing the down arrow to browse downwards no longer selects hidden items covered by the help menu or command list. ⟦In a quick-note folder, filed drafts tucked into sleeves once hid from searches, but now clipped notes are never misplaced and keyword lookups peer straight through the sleeves.⟧ In addition, pressing Ctrl+R in the terminal to search prompt history now matches text collapsed inside pasted text pills.

items.original:
Fixed pasted text and dragged-in files being lost in Claude's question dialog unless the "Other" row had focus
Fixed pasted text being lost when a row in the prompt footer was selected
Fixed ↓ selecting footer items hidden by the ? help menu, the command list or a paste hint
Improved prompt history: Ctrl+R now matches text inside collapsed `[Pasted text]` pills

title.zh-TW: 自託管執行器斷線暫停保護，未推送分支明確指引解法
title.en: Protect disconnected self-hosted runner pauses and provide clear fixes for unpushed branches

body.zh-TW: 採用自託管執行器運行工作階段時，網路短暫閃斷或分支未同步，往往會造成除錯上的困難。當閒置工作階段請求暫停時，若執行器在收到官方確認前斷線，系統現在會安全地進入暫停狀態，不再錯誤地將工作階段轉移到其他執行器上。當工作階段指定的分支未在遠端 Git 儲存庫找到時，錯誤提示現在涵蓋了從未推送分支的情境，並給予各個情況對應的修復步驟，不再盲目建議重試。⟦就像工班師傅暫時離開工位，現場會原地保留待命，不再擅自把半成品轉給別組；若施工圖在檔案夾找不到，也直接標明去哪補圖，不再盲目重試。⟧
body.en: When using self-hosted runners to run sessions, brief network drops or unsynced branches often create debugging difficulties. When an idle session requests to pause, if the runner loses its connection before receiving official confirmation, the system now enters a paused state safely instead of mistakenly migrating the session to another runner. When the branch specified for a session is not found on the remote Git repository, the error message now covers cases where the branch was never pushed, providing corresponding remediation steps for each situation rather than blindly suggesting a retry. ⟦When a tradesperson steps away from the workbench, the site stays on standby instead of passing unfinished pieces to another crew, and missing blueprints point directly to the right cabinet instead of prompting blind retries.⟧

items.original:
Self-hosted runner: Fixed an idle session moving to another runner instead of pausing when the runner's request to pause it lost its connection before Anthropic answered
Self-hosted runner: Improved the error shown when a session's branch isn't on the git remote: it now covers a never-pushed branch, says how to fix each case, and no longer suggests retrying

title.zh-TW: 設計同步預覽增減檔案，資料視覺化改用長條圖呈現
title.en: Preview file changes in design sync and switch data visualization to bar charts

body.zh-TW: 呼叫專屬技能產生圖表或同步專案設計時，更清晰的提示與更專業的圖表能節省反覆確認的時間。輸入 `/design-sync` 同步設計時，確認提示會詳細列出目標資料夾、專案名稱以及即將上傳或刪除的檔案清單。內建的資料視覺化技能在面對圓餅圖或甜甜圈圖需求時，改為建議使用排序長條圖或帶有數值的堆疊長條圖呈現，且在數字長度允許時建議完整標示座標軸刻度。⟦跟裝修工程進場施工一樣，開工前在清單上清楚勾選拆除與進場物件，設計圖改用直觀的刻度尺規，避免了圓盤圖表的判讀誤差。⟧此外，API 技能更新了 Datadog 追蹤標頭使其與主控台一致，並簡化安裝步驟，且在調整受管代理前會主動要求先讀取完整工作流程。
body.en: When invoking specialized skills to generate charts or synchronize project designs, clearer prompts and more professional charts save back-and-forth confirmation time. When entering `/design-sync` to sync designs, the confirmation prompt lists the destination folder, project name, and files scheduled for upload or deletion in detail.
